Welcome to my channel 💕✨

I'm a qualified beauty therapist sharing all things self-care, beauty and wellness. Expect relaxing beauty content, skincare, facials, massage, nails, beauty routines, self-care days and tips to help you make a little more time for yourself. Whether you're doing your skincare, having a self-care night, studying, working or simply need something relaxing in the background, you'll also find calming lo-fi mixes and peaceful ambience to help you switch off.🧖🏽‍♀️💆🏽‍♀️

On this channel you'll find:
✨ Self-care routines & reset days
💆🏽‍♀️ Massage & relaxation
🧖🏽‍♀️ Facials & skincare
💅🏽 Nails & beauty maintenance
🎀 At-home beauty treatments
🌸 Beauty therapist tips
💕 Wellness & feel good content
🌙 Cosy spa and relaxation ambience

If you love beauty, relaxing routines and making self-care part of your lifestyle, you're in the right place.

Subscribe and make yourself at home ✨
